name: SCP: Containment Breach
desc:
WARNING this game contains moderate flashing lights.

SCPs have broken out of the Facility! Do what you must to survive, and you might just make it out of the Containment Breach! Play as a Class D, and escape! Play as a Guard, find a Researcher, and rescue them! Or Play as an SCP and cause extreme mayhem!

Join our server and group to interact with the community, suggest new features, report bugs, and get more updates!
